title: DR Live
summary: Shows a recovery test in real time and the cost of every minute of downtime.
lead: Watch a recovery in real time, and what every minute of downtime costs.
problem: Talking about RTO and RPO with leadership tends to stay abstract. It's hard to grasp what an hour of downtime means if you've never seen one.
idea: A screen that shows a recovery test progressing live, group by group, next to the running cost of every minute of downtime.
change: The conversation moves from concepts to something you can see. I used it in the webinar "DR that isn't tested isn't DR".
role: I designed the screen, built the real-time tracking of each group and the cost-per-minute calculation, and used it live in the webinar.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
